Angel Food Cake With Strawberries
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 8, 2009 - 11:52pm

Ingredients




1 angel food cake, torn into pieces
1 qt. vanilla ice cream
2 cups milk
2 sm. boxes vanilla instant pudding
2 sm. boxes strawberry Jello
2 cups hot water
Frozen berries (4 c. berries, ½ c. sugar)

Preparation

1 Mix milk and pudding. Add softened ice cream. Pour over cake. Mix and chill until slightly thickened Jello, water, berries, and sugar. Pour over top of cake. Refrigerate.
